governance.purpose: Prospectively test whether the continuous-adjustment estimator generalises beyond a nuisance geometry exactly representable by its frozen ridge basis.

why_needed: The successful NEG_TECH_2 nuisance is scaled by degree and inverse distance, and the frozen adjustment basis includes distance, degree and their interaction. A green result therefore demonstrates correction under a nearly well-specified nuisance surface, not robustness to arbitrary geometry-coupled hidden quality.

single_new_negative.name: NEG_TECH_OUTSPAN_1
single_new_negative.construction: Use the same hidden-quality latent hq as NEG_TECH_2, but multiply the ATAC-side loading by a smooth non-monotonic geometry function outside the frozen 14-feature ridge span.
single_new_negative.geometry_function: g = zscore( sin(2.5 * z_log_distance) + 0.5 * tanh(z_degree * z_anchor_frequency) + 0.35 * z_accessibility * z_re_density )
constraints: no target labels or linked status enter g
the function is fixed here before execution
effect amplitude on RNA and ATAC remains 0.60 as in NEG_TECH_2
measured-depth and orthogonal hidden-quality mixing remains unchanged from NEG_TECH_2
all other tournament worlds, seeds, positives and nuisance families remain unchanged

forbidden: adding sin/tanh/basis terms to fit this negative
choosing a new nuisance function after seeing the result

qualification.same_rule: Every represented nuisance family, now including OUTSPAN_TECH, must have one-sided LCB95 > M_MIN=0.010.
support_requirements: Kish ESS and contribution concentration reported
held-out ambient family remains held out and reported

interpretation.A_outspan_passes: Evidence that the continuous estimator generalises beyond exact nuisance-model specification within this prospectively frozen misspecification class.
interpretation.B_outspan_fails_only: The estimator is qualified only for nuisance surfaces within/near its frozen model span. Do not generalise to arbitrary hidden-quality geometry in real data.
interpretation.C_existing_family_breaks: STOP; the successor invalidates broader qualification.
interpretation.D_support_concentrates: Treat as disguised support failure, not a pass.

scope: This is an empirical misspecification stress, not a theorem-level identifiability test.
